verdict.rationale: Exa has a dedicated rate-limits doc page confirming default rate limits exist, and a pricing page referencing paid tiers with expanded features (async deep research, scheduled searches), implying a self-serve upgrade path, but the evidence pack lacks concrete documented numeric rate limits/concurrency caps or details on how upgrading changes those caps. missing for 10: specific numeric rate-limit/concurrency figures per tier, explicit self-serve upgrade flow (billing dashboard/plan change) description, independent confirmation of limits in practice.
